claim: Patchline ships an external meta-analytic pooling of independent studies with heterogeneity diagnostics. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the external meta-analysis claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make external-meta-analysis-gate`.
